component.name: KeyFlip
component.summary: Switch your laptop between portable and desk setups

description.p: KeyFlip is a GNOME utility for safely enabling or disabling a supported laptop's internal keyboard while keeping external USB and Bluetooth keyboards available.

Use Laptop Mode when you want the built-in keyboard active, or Desk Mode when you are working with an external keyboard and want to avoid accidental input. KeyFlip also includes GNOME panel controls, a global shortcut, and optional automatic switching when external keyboards connect or disconnect.
KeyFlip currently supports standard i8042/AT internal keyboards and is designed for Fedora GNOME on Wayland and X11.

description.p: Adds Laptop Mode and Desk Mode presets, GNOME panel controls, a global shortcut, and external-keyboard safety checks.
